title: Step 6: Framework adapters
summary: LangChain BaseChatMessageHistory, OpenAI Agents SDK Session, MCP tools — all optional extras.
description:
Build three thin adapters on top of the Step 3-5 core, each in its own
optional-dependency submodule (agent_memory_sdk.adapters.langchain,
.openai_agents, .mcp):
1. LangChain: implement BaseChatMessageHistory backed by store.working,
   and optionally a BaseStore implementation for facts/profiles.
2. OpenAI Agents SDK: implement the Session protocol backed by
   store.working + store.episodic.
3. MCP: expose remember/recall/forget/list as MCP tools so any
   MCP-compatible agent can use the SDK without a Python import.

Keep the core package importable with zero adapter dependencies installed;
gate each adapter behind an extras_require group in pyproject.toml
(e.g. `pip install agent-memory-sdk[langchain]`).

comments.text: Built three thin adapters under src/agent_memory_sdk/adapters/. (1) LangChain: Db2ChatMessageHistory (BaseChatMessageHistory duck-type backed by store.working — messages round-trip through JSON metadata preserving HumanMessage/AIMessage/ToolMessage types) + Db2MemoryStore (BaseStore[str,str] backed by store.facts or store.profiles, keyed by metadata[store_key]). (2) OpenAI Agents SDK: Db2Session (Session protocol backed by store.working, messages stored as JSON dicts; bonus recall_episodes() searches store.episodic at agent+user scope). (3) MCP: create_server(store) factory exposing remember/recall/forget/list_memories tools; recall falls back to recency list when no query_embedding is provided; tools return TextContent(text=json_string). All framework imports deferred behind _require_*() guards — core remains importable with zero adapter deps. pyproject.toml extras groups already present from earlier steps. 48 new unit tests; all 243 tests pass, ruff clean, mypy strict clean.
